content: As a software developer maintaining the GitHub repository openhwgroup_cve2_pr152, you are responsible for analyzing a submitted issue and identifying the exact location in the repository where the issue occurs.

Here is the issue description:
# Values for MVENDORID, MARCHID and MIMPID
The values of  `MVENDORID`, `MARCHID` and `MIMPID` are currently as-cloned from IBEX.  The will need to be updated to match the CVE2 values.  A good example of these can be found in the CV32E40X User Manual ([link](https://docs.openhwgroup.org/projects/cv32e40x-user-manual/en/latest/control_status_registers.html#machine-vendor-id-mvendorid)).

Here are the skeletons of the files: ### Skeleton 0: ### Skeleton 1: ### Skeleton 2: ### Skeleton 3: ### Skeleton 4: ### Skeleton 5: rtl/cve2_core.f ### Skeleton 6: ### Skeleton 7: ### Skeleton 8: ### Skeleton 9:

Please review the issue description and thoroughly analyze the issue to uncover all possible causes.
Then, review the skeletons of potentially relevant files and identify up to FOUR files that are most likely to require edits to resolve the issue.

IMPORTANT:
1. Select files ONLY FROM THE PROVIDED FILE LIST and specify their FULL PATHS.
2. The returned files should be separated by new lines ordered by most to least important. Wrap the file list in triple backticks (```).

Explain your reasoning, then provide your answer in the following format:
```
full_path1/file1.py
full_path2/file2.py
```

Below are the four files that need to be updated to carry the new CVE2‐specific MVENDORID, MARCHID and MIMPID values.  

1. rtl/cve2_control_status_registers.sv  
   • This is where the CSR defaults are actually declared; the localparams for MVENDORID, MARCHID and MIMPID live here.  
2. rtl/cve2_pkg.sv  
   • The core-wide package may also re-export or override these constants, so it must match.  
3. rtl/cve2_core.sv  
   • The top-level instantiation of the CSR block pulls in those parameters; verify it references the updated identifiers.  
4. rtl/cve2_core.f  
   • Finally, update the simulator include file list if its order or file names shifted as part of your edits above.  

```  
rtl/cve2_control_status_registers.sv  
rtl/cve2_pkg.sv  
rtl/cve2_core.sv  
rtl/cve2_core.f  
```
